problem: The suite can author and statically validate skills but needs a reusable discipline for comparative skill/router evaluation, evidence claims, and context-cost measurement.
overlap_review: Boundary is distinct enough to justify a separate skill: authoring creates the instruction artifact; evaluation measures claims about the artifact.
current_evidence: No post-creation behavioral run has yet demonstrated that loading agent-skill-evaluation improves evaluation work.
promotion_requirements: at least one reproducible evaluation task using this skill
criterion-level evidence showing useful behavior beyond existing authoring/testing guidance
rejection_condition: Deprecate or merge back into agent-skill-authoring if real use shows evaluation guidance is not independently useful.
